description: Add elements. Coordinates: px (default) are absolute canvas pixels and are NOT offset — start at the origin reported by whiteboard_read (values are clamped into the usable area). pct = 0-100 of the usable area (offsets applied; also converts arrow/pen points). parent:<sectionId> makes x/y relative to that section and clamps inside it. layout row/column/grid/center overrides x/y using real sizes. Sizes: text/list auto-size (do not pass width/height); shapes default 160x100 (rect, pill, circle, triangle, drawn-circle); sections default per sectionType; images need width/height. Arrows: 2+ points plus optional startAnchor/endAnchor (unknown IDs dropped with a warning; anchored ends snap to the target edge). Returns the FINAL geometry per element after defaults/pct/layout/clamping with the adjustments made, then overflow/overlap warnings for the new elements. Guidance: keep content within ~70-80% of the usable width, centered, fit vertically, ~20px margins.

coordMode.description: "px" (default): absolute canvas pixels — NOT offset; the usable area starts at the origin whiteboard_read reports and values are clamped into it. "pct": 0-100 of the usable area (or of the parent section when parent is set); offsets applied; also converts arrow/pen points.

color.description: CSS color. Default rgba(255,255,255,0.85). Palette: #ef4444 red, #f97316 orange, #eab308 yellow, #22c55e green, #3b82f6 blue, #a855f7 purple, #ec4899 pink, #06b6d4 cyan

content.description: Text content (text). \n = line break. Text does not wrap: long single lines get wide.

endAnchor.description: Element ID the arrow end snaps to.

fontSize.description: Font size px. Defaults: text 22, list 18.

id.description: Optional ID. Must be unique; a taken ID is regenerated and reported (requestedId).

items.description: List items (list). One entry per bullet: a string (top level) or {text, level} for a nested bullet (level 0-4; sub-items of the item above). Nested levels are indented with their own bullet / numbering style.

level.description: Nesting level, 0 = top (default). At most one deeper than the item above (deeper is lowered); the first item is always 0. Max 4.

label.description: Section label (section). Defaults to the section type name.

ordered.description: Numbered list instead of bullets (list). Default false.

parent.description: Section ID. x/y (px or pct) become relative to that section box and the element is clamped inside it. Not stored — a moved section does not move its children.

points.description: [[x,y],...] waypoints for arrow/pen (2+). Converted with pct too.

sectionType.description: Section semantics (section); sets default size/color/label. Default content.

startAnchor.description: Element ID the arrow start snaps to (edge intersection). Unknown IDs are dropped with a warning.

url.description: Image path served by the Neural Interface (e.g. "/games/TicTacToe/Cross.svg"); must resolve inside public/ or games/. Server embeds it as a dataUrl.

width.description: Width (shape/image/section). Ignored for text/list — they auto-size.

x.description: X in canvas px (or % of the frame with coordMode pct). Required unless layout is set.

layout.description: Auto-layout using real element sizes; overrides x/y. Runs inside the parent section when parent is set.

name: whiteboard_add
